experiment: F04 explicit premise/citation + separate gap and rationale

samples.notes: True group-size quotation does not support responsiveness. Unknown identity not falsely resolved.
No decorative quote, but both gap and rationale presuppose a most-recently responsive contact without confirmation; ambiguity/unsupported presupposition fails conservative facts/usefulness gate.
Relevant quote identifies unconfirmed own current case; no known reply reopened.
Honest eligibility gap and private check. Omits available relevant correction rather than demonstrating a premise/citation relationship; rationale adds generic urgency framing.
Alternative-route check stays private but group-size quote is weak; efficacy wording is generic.
Honest supplied-record gap about another permitted route. Does not infer disinterest or claim another tester exists. Rationale is generic; no generated premise/citation pair.
Forced true group-size citation is irrelevant to intended contact eligibility.
Honest record-scoped evidence gap, but rationale invents financial-data framing and role criteria unrelated to the task. Narrow abstention gain, material rationale regression.
Mixed-person quote includes intended identity but does not establish eligibility. No explicit transfer of the other person eligibility is asserted.
Honest intended-person gap and useful private check; does not borrow another person status. No premise/citation relationship generated.
Relevant current correction preserved over older positive case status.
Current uncertainty preserved, but available relevant correction is uncited and rationale invokes CFO criteria rather than actual case-specific evidence.
Quote correctly says reply occurred while own case/willingness remain unknown; no invented positive compound claim.
Accurate scoped gap; useful check remains. No compound premise emitted, so this does not test successful detection of partial entailment.
Current eligibility-uncertainty quote is relevant; no forced use of every source needed.
Accurate eligibility gap but available relevant evidence is uncited; financial-role justification returns. Does not exercise support from multiple citations.

conclusion: Candidate removes decorative quotes by using evidence gaps in every case, but does not demonstrate improved premise/citation support. Partial abstention improvement, unsupported responsive-contact presupposition and irrelevant financial-role rationale remain. Keep isolated; F04 not resolved.
limits: Eight maker-exposed development cases, single CFO/same-setting attempt per arm, not independent success rates, blind held-out, full team or owner review. All tasks have unresolved target eligibility/contact status; null premise can be honest, so absence of citation is not automatically a failure. Positive factual support behavior was not demonstrated. No citation correctness percentage with zero candidate citations. Both arms600token cap vs400in previous runs; prompt/schema combined intervention; steps supplied by workflow, not model. No automatic semantic checker or overall usefulness percentage.
